# CollabHub

> CollabHub is an Apache-2.0 TypeScript toolkit for adding server-validated, structured multiplayer collaboration to an existing React application without replacing its components, data model, store, business commands, or REST fallback.

The stable release is v1.0.0. CollabHub is designed for structured application state such as tasks, forms, ordered sections, graphs, and block-level documents. It is not a character-level text CRDT. The application continues to own authentication, document permissions, business rules, and its primary data model.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/README.md): Product overview, examples, minimal integration, and deployment choices.
- [Five-minute integration guide](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Add CollabHub to an existing React app.
- [AI Coding guide](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/ai-coding-guide.md): A bounded workflow for coding agents and vibe-coded projects.
- [Live React Flow demo](https://collabhub-demo.onrender.com/demo.html): Shareable two-client collaboration workspace.
- [API stability](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/api-stability.md): Stable v1 contracts and compatibility policy.

## Integration guides

- [TODO List](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/integration/todo-list-tutorial.en.md): Commands, linked fields, list ordering, REST fallback, and double-write protection.
- [BlockNote](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/integration/blocknote.en.md): Block-level insert, delete, reorder, coalescing, and recovery.
- [React Flow](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/integration/react-flow.en.md): Incremental graph operations, drag coalescing, and linked-edge deletion.
- [CollabHub plus Yjs](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/integration/yjs-hybrid.md): Use CollabHub for structured fields and Yjs for a character-level rich-text body.
- [Integration readiness](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/integration/readiness.en.md): Authentication, storage ownership, testing, and rollout checklist.

## Deployment

- [AWS single VM](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/deploy/aws/README.md): Terraform deployment to AWS Lightsail from $12/month, including PostgreSQL, Redis, TLS, and local backups.
- [Independent-developer VM](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/deploy/indie/README.md): Cloud-neutral persistent single-VM Docker Compose profile.
- [Existing VM cluster](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/deploy/vm/README.md): Multi-node runtime with external PostgreSQL, Redis, and load balancing.
- [Kubernetes](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/tree/main/deploy/kubernetes): Kustomize baseline for a multi-node deployment.
- [Alibaba Cloud](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/deploy/alicloud/README.md): Certified Alibaba Cloud production reference.
- [Production hardening](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/production-hardening.md): Security, migrations, retention, recovery, and operations.

## Architecture

- [Architecture overview](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/architecture/overview.en.md): Protocol, Client Core, Server Core, Domain Pack, and adapter boundaries.
- [Protocol](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/architecture/protocol.en.md): Versioned operations, canonical patches, idempotency, rejection, and recovery.
- [Horizontal scaling](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/architecture/horizontal-scaling.en.md): Gateway, Room Worker, PostgreSQL, Redis, fencing, and failover.
- [Capabilities](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md): Supported collaboration behavior and evidence.

## Boundaries

- [Known limitations](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/known-limitations.en.md): Explicit v1 exclusions and operating constraints.
- [CollabHub or Yjs](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/choosing-collabhub-or-yjs.md): Choose structured server-validated collaboration, character-level CRDTs, or a hybrid.
- [Acceptance evidence](https://github.com/superche/collabhub/blob/main/docs/acceptance.en.md): Automated tests, real browser smoke tests, cloud verification, and performance baselines.
